sources.notes: Authoritative for monetary policy, repo rates, banking regulations, payment systems (UPI, NEFT, RTGS), Forex/FEMA rules, RBI Retail Direct g-sec guidelines, and master circulars. Cannot establish individual income-tax rules.

sources.officialName: RBI Complaint Management System (CMS) & Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
sources.accessLimitations: Public portal for lodging and tracking escalation complaints
sources.notes: Covers Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS, 2021) encompassing commercial banks, NBFCs, and non-bank payment system participants.

sources.officialName: Securities and Exchange Board of India Official Portal
sources.publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
sources.notes: Authoritative for Mutual Fund categorisation regulations (2017 circular), REIT/InvIT frameworks, AIF guidelines, insider trading prohibitions, broker regulations, and capital market disclosure mandates.

sources.publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India
sources.notes: Authoritative process for investor dispute resolution against listed companies, brokers, depository participants, and mutual fund AMCs.

sources.publisher: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.accessLimitations: Public guidance, authenticated portal for ITR filing
sources.notes: Authoritative for Income-tax Act 1961, tax slabs under Old vs New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC), Capital Gains Tax schedules (STCG Section 111A, LTCG Section 112A), TDS rules, and official CBDT circulars.

sources.officialName: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority Official Portal
sources.notes: Authoritative for National Pension System (NPS Tier 1 & Tier 2) rules, Atal Pension Yojana (APY), annuity mandatory purchase fractions, and withdrawal rules.

sources.publisher: EPFO, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.notes: Authoritative for EPF interest rates, EPS pension computations, EDLI insurance, voluntary provident fund (VPF), and withdrawal/taxation thresholds on contributions > ₹2.5 Lakh per annum.

sources.officialName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India Portal
sources.notes: Authoritative for life, health, motor, and general insurance regulations, claim settlement ratio (CSR) disclosures, policyholder protection regulations, and health cashless guidelines.

sources.officialName: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation Portal
sources.publisher: DICGC (Subsidiary of Reserve Bank of India)
sources.notes: Authoritative for bank deposit insurance cover limit (up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor per insured bank across principal and interest) under DICGC Act.

sources.officialName: Association of Mutual Funds in India Portal
sources.publisher: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
sources.notes: Authoritative for mutual fund NAV history, monthly AUM flows, scheme reclassifications, TER reporting standards, and ARN compliance. Must be verified against SEBI regulations for legal mandates.
